svg.text: Feature lattice of the 194 Monster-irrep badges — similar badges placed together
columns = the dominant Ogg prime (the loudest polygon); only six occur (2,3,5,7,13,47) so there are six distinct visual groups
within a column badges are stacked by decreasing exponent sum, so the vertical neighbour is the closest sibling in magnitude
clustering is real: mean l1 within a group 86043/4557 ~ 18.9 < between groups 447814/14164 ~ 31.6
vertical neighbours 2001/188 ~ 10.6 < random pairs 533857/18721 ~ 28.5 : adjacent really means similar
